title: Approve the proposed split
summary: The human gate for a bundled goal, research request or multi-part question that the kernel offers to split. Two samples: a jev_none goal (reject ends the run blocked) and a bundled_accepted goal of seven parts, where five are offered and two are listed read-only as not covered, ask again (reject keeps it whole). Shows each part with its verbatim span, dependencies and capability, one dropped proposal, and the answers: approve, edit, pick a subset, reject.
